purpose: Governed quote-safety rules for Wingman scenario lead products. These are commercial verification postures, not invented product specifications.

MX-0808-KIT-V2.reason: Confirm routed source/display requirement, display distances, receiver count, audio handling and control method before quoting.

NHD-CTL-PRO.reason: Confirm NetworkHD series, endpoint count, managed switch design, VLAN/IGMP requirements and control workflow before quoting.

APO-VX20-UC.reason: Confirm BYOD/BYOM workflow, USB host ownership, camera/microphone/speaker behaviour, room size and casting requirement before quoting.

MX-1007-HYB.reason: Confirm teaching-room source count, display zoning, USB requirement, audio/DSP needs, amplifier requirement and control workflow before quoting.

SW-0204-VW.reason: Confirm wall layout, source count, preset layouts, bezel compensation, output resolution and control behaviour before quoting.

SW-0206-VW.reason: Confirm wall layout, source count, mixed layouts, bezel compensation, output resolution and control behaviour before quoting.

NHD-0401-MV.reason: Confirm LED processor input format, canvas resolution, required source layouts, HDCP handling and control workflow before quoting.

NHD-128-NDI-TRX.reason: Confirm NDI source type, encode/decode workflow, network design, bandwidth, output path and multiview/recording requirement before quoting.

NHD-150-RX.reason: Confirm NetworkHD 100-series system design, source count, multiview layout, decoder output requirement and controller/network dependencies before quoting.
